text: Ever wondered why your skin does not simply keep getting thicker, when cells in it go on dividing for your whole life? In a healthy adult tissue that is maintaining its size, cells are continually lost, worn away at the surface, and new cells made by mitosis replace them. Cells made and cells lost stay roughly in balance. Now picture one cell that stops keeping to that balance and just goes on dividing. That is where a tumour can begin.
